title: Add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Priya Desai
description:
This PR adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) templates, three agent quickstarts demonstrating tool-calling patterns, and updates the docs site navigation and example index. Motivation: make it easy for developers to onboard to RAG+agent workflows with copy-pasteable examples and to surface tool-calling patterns in the docs site. Changes are intentionally small and runnable locally so the examples can be used in tutorials and onboarding sessions. Checklist:
- [x] Add RAG templates (python + ts) and templates README
- [x] Add 3 agent quickstarts: search+toolchain, multi-tool orchestration, and safety-guarded tool-calling
- [x] Add tool-calling examples demonstrating function signatures, structured outputs, and fallback policies
- [x] Update docs site sidebar and quickstarts index
- [x] Add smoke tests and CI example build
- [x] Address link-checker issues and doc build warnings
Notes: the examples use the redwood SDKs and the new templates/agents folder layout to keep things discoverable. There are no API changes or breaking behavior in the runtime. Related: ENG-4821 (RAG quickstart), PM-739 (docs quickstart prioritization).
commits: feat(docs): add rag/templates with python and ts examples
